name: Chlorphentermine

summary: Chlorphentermine was pulled from the market in Germany and Venezuela starting in 1967 due to harm caused to the heart and breathing system [3]. In tests from a small computer model rather than studies in people, the drug received a low risk score of 20 for the liver and a high risk score of 70 for the heart [M]. Similar drugs have also been removed from markets in various countries due to heart, breathing, or liver damage [3][4].
